mapper.sql: id, username, real_name, phone, department, status, is_deleted, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, remark
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT id, username, real_name, password, phone, department, status, is_deleted, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, remark FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (id, username, real_name, password, phone, department, status, is_deleted, created_at, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{realName}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{department}, #{status}, 0, NOW(), #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password}, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.permission FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.menu_type = 'F' AND m.status = 1 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.permission IS NOT NULL
